title: Decoded output preserves expected value
statement: Let $D$ be a finite nonempty label set, and consider a finite predicate template, a finite randomized CSP input, binary input and output encodings with decoding inverse to encoding and canonical successful decodings, and an adapter algorithm that maps each encoded input to the encoding of the packed assignment in its conditional-expectation plan. For every encoded input, decoding the algorithm's output gives that packed assignment, and the value of the plan's assignment is at least the expected CSP value of the randomized assignment.
hypotheses_covered: Binary input and output encodings with the stated inverse properties
Adapter algorithm has the specified output on every encoded input
